title: Data Analyst
description:
.

Data Analyst - Banking / Operational Excellence

Contract: Initial 16 weeks, with strong potential for extension
Start Date: ASAP
Location: London - City
Level: Consultant / Senior Consultant equivalent

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Data Analyst to support an operational excellence programme within a major bank.

Working directly with the Relationship Management Lead and wider banking teams, you will play a critical role in driving a data-led transformation, identifying operational inefficiencies, informing interventions and measuring performance improvements.

You will also leverage Microsoft Copilot to develop and deploy AI agents that improve the productivity of frontline banking teams.

Key Responsibilities
  • Analyse operational performance, including daily productivity, efficiency, throughput and points of failure.
  • Develop Power BI dashboards, actionable insights and progress reports.
  • Work directly with Relationship Managers to identify opportunities for operational improvement.
  • Build and deploy Microsoft Copilot agents to support day-to-day banking activities.
  • Establish performance baselines and measure the impact of operational interventions.
  • Present findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
Skills & Experience
  • Strong data analysis and Power BI capabilities.
  • Experience delivering operational excellence or business transformation programmes within banking.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio, including building and deploying AI agents.
  • Understanding of business banking, ideally Business Current Accounts.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication and presentation skills.
  • Previous management consulting or client-facing transformation experience preferred.
  • Ability to operate autonomously within a fast-paced, delivery-focused environment.
  • The initial engagement is for 16 weeks, with the opportunity to extend into a broader transformation programme across additional banking products.
